weeks.content:
Greet the Nigerian way in our cultures
Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo greetings

Recite the pledge
Sing the anthem with respect

Green, white, green
Colour the flag craft

Teacher, doctor, nurse
Say how they help us

Police, soldier, firefighter
They keep us safe

Greet the trader
Say please and thank you when buying

Sit in the car, wear the belt
Do not wave from the window

Knock before entering
Greet the host and sit nicely

Do not litter the street
Keep our estate and school clean

Dress as a community helper
Say what my helper does
